description: Vallado's worked IAU-76/FK5 reduction (Fundamentals of Astrodynamics and Applications, Example 3-15; identical LEO test case published in AAS 06-675 and AIAA 2006-6753 Rev 3). Input is the ITRF state; every leg's published position must be reproduced to <= 1 m with the fixture's EOP inputs.

eop.note: dut1/xp/yp from ex3_15.m (AAS 06-675 rounds dut1 to -0.439962 s; AIAA 2006-6753 Rev 3 to -0.439961 s - sub-mm effect). lod affects only the omega magnitude in velocity terms (~mm/s here); ddpsi/ddeps are the EOP nutation corrections, recorded for completeness but NOT applied by the IAU-76/FK5 provider under test (compare against the *_iau76 rows).

input.source: Vallado, Seago, Seidelmann, 'Implementation Issues Surrounding the New IAU Reference Frameworks' (AAS 06-675), LEO test case, p. 17. https://www.agi.com/getmedia/2a33d303-9a4e-4520-9da0-86a4d5e45a10/Implementation-Issues-Surrounding-the-New-IAU-Reference-Systems-for-Astrodynamics.pdf (row 'ITRF'); inputs also in CelesTrak/fundamentals-of-astrodynamics companion code, software/matlab/ex3_15.m (input epoch and EOP for Example 3-15). https://github.com/CelesTrak/fundamentals-of-astrodynamics/blob/main/software/matlab/ex3_15.m

published.source: Vallado, Seago, Seidelmann, 'Implementation Issues Surrounding the New IAU Reference Frameworks' (AAS 06-675), LEO test case, p. 17. https://www.agi.com/getmedia/2a33d303-9a4e-4520-9da0-86a4d5e45a10/Implementation-Issues-Surrounding-the-New-IAU-Reference-Systems-for-Astrodynamics.pdf (row 'PEF iau76')
published.note: Polar motion removed (W^T with the fixture xp/yp).

published.source: Vallado, Seago, Seidelmann, 'Implementation Issues Surrounding the New IAU Reference Frameworks' (AAS 06-675), LEO test case, p. 17. https://www.agi.com/getmedia/2a33d303-9a4e-4520-9da0-86a4d5e45a10/Implementation-Issues-Surrounding-the-New-IAU-Reference-Systems-for-Astrodynamics.pdf (row 'TOD iau76')
published.note: PEF spun to true-of-date by GAST-1982 (GMST82 + full equation of the equinoxes).

published.source: Vallado, Seago, Seidelmann, 'Implementation Issues Surrounding the New IAU Reference Frameworks' (AAS 06-675), LEO test case, p. 17. https://www.agi.com/getmedia/2a33d303-9a4e-4520-9da0-86a4d5e45a10/Implementation-Issues-Surrounding-the-New-IAU-Reference-Systems-for-Astrodynamics.pdf (row 'MOD iau76')
published.note: IAU-1980 nutation removed (full 106-term series, no ddpsi/ddeps corrections).

published.source: Vallado, Seago, Seidelmann, 'Implementation Issues Surrounding the New IAU Reference Frameworks' (AAS 06-675), LEO test case, p. 17. https://www.agi.com/getmedia/2a33d303-9a4e-4520-9da0-86a4d5e45a10/Implementation-Issues-Surrounding-the-New-IAU-Reference-Systems-for-Astrodynamics.pdf (row 'J2000 iau76')
published.note: IAU-76 precession removed. This is the classical IAU-76/FK5 'J2000' result WITHOUT ddpsi/ddeps EOP corrections - the exact chain Iau76Fk5Provider implements. It differs from true GCRF by the ~0.023 arcsec frame bias (~0.7 m at this radius); see gcrf_with_eop_corrections for the corrected row.

astropy_iau2006_2000a.note: astropy GCRS/TEME with the fixture EOP forced (dUT1 at the IERS-table layer, patched polar-motion lookup); IAU-2006/2000A theory, so it differs from the IAU-76/FK5 published rows by frame bias + nutation-theory deltas.

published.source: Vallado, Crawford, Hujsak, Kelso, 'Revisiting Spacetrack Report #3' (AIAA 2006-6753, Rev 3), Appendix C - TEME Coordinate System, p. 32. https://celestrak.org/publications/AIAA/2006-6753/AIAA-2006-6753-Rev3.pdf
published.note: TEME = R3(-GMST82) applied to PEF (equivalently R3(+EqEquinox) applied to TOD).

astropy_iau2006_2000a.note: astropy GCRS/TEME with the fixture EOP forced (dUT1 at the IERS-table layer, patched polar-motion lookup); IAU-2006/2000A theory, so it differs from the IAU-76/FK5 published rows by frame bias + nutation-theory deltas.

gcrf_with_eop_corrections.source: Vallado, Seago, Seidelmann, 'Implementation Issues Surrounding the New IAU Reference Frameworks' (AAS 06-675), LEO test case, p. 17. https://www.agi.com/getmedia/2a33d303-9a4e-4520-9da0-86a4d5e45a10/Implementation-Issues-Surrounding-the-New-IAU-Reference-Systems-for-Astrodynamics.pdf (row 'GCRF iau76 w corr')
gcrf_with_eop_corrections.note: Informational: IAU-76/FK5 WITH ddpsi/ddeps applied (true GCRF to ~1 cm).

generator_self_check_residuals.note: Independent pyerfa IAU-76/FK5 chain vs the published rows at generation time (guards the transcription; not a fixture target).
